title: Cross-economy inflation-differential MOMENTUM conditioning (63-day rate-of-change of the y/y gap -- the change of the gap, never its level; zero spot content in the driver)
mechanism: WHO IS FORCED/SLOW: trend-allocating macro books, reserve managers and insurance/pension currency-hedge committees review RELATIVE inflation performance on periodic clocks (monthly to quarterly), and policy rates respond to inflation paths at meeting cadence with explicit lags -- so a change in the realized inflation differential is absorbed into rate-path pricing and positioning over weeks, not minutes. WHY: inflation is a persistent process (Fuhrer) -- once the home-minus-US y/y gap has moved over a quarter, its sign tends to persist, and the Taylor-rule response (Molodtsova-Papell: relative-inflation terms carry out-of-sample exchange-rate predictability) keeps repricing in the direction of the gap's change for as long as the change persists; Rogoff's measured multi-year PPP adjustment half-life guarantees the real side cannot neutralize the move quickly. The mechanism is therefore about the RATE-OF-CHANGE of the differential -- a first difference, NOT the gap's level (the level form appears ONLY inside the control arm, mirroring the V8 AX2-C8 discipline). OBSERVABLE, TO FIELD LEVEL: for pair p with home economy h, define gap_p(x) = pi_h(latest print as-of x) - pi_US(latest print as-of x), each leg's chained y/y (rebase-safe AX2-C3) read under a SINGLE as-of snapshot at instant x; driver M(t) = gap_p(t) - gap_p(t-63 calendar days), where BOTH snapshots use as-bound vintaged values available at their own instants (no current-vintage pulls, no retrospective recomputation of the earlier gap). Units: pp per quarter-scale window. DIRECTION: M(t) >= +0.15pp => long home currency; M(t) <= -0.15pp => short home currency (per-pair home_sign_map); dead/exit band |M| <= 0.10pp; state persists on the universal daily grid -- no release window, no k-day post-release hold. WHEN IT MUST FAIL: (i) if gap changes are fully impounded at the print instant (no continuation), post-state drift is zero and expectancy dies at 6.0 bps round trips; (ii) if the gap's LEVEL, not its change, is what spot prices -- the differential-LEVEL control reproduces the anchor (R1) and the momentum identity is words; (iii) if the edge is a release-schedule artifact (quarterly step function timing rather than content), the +7d sham neighbour out-earns (R2); (iv) if momentum is y/y base-effect arithmetic with no policy content, the frozen sign inverts spuriously and gate 1 rejects.
literature_anchors: Fuhrer (1997) 'The (New) Keynesian Economics and the Output-Inflation Trade-Off' (BPEQ) -- inflation persistence: changes in realized inflation differentials keep their sign, making the rate-of-change a state, not noise

Molodtsova & Papell (2009) 'Out-of-sample exchange rate predictability with Taylor rule fundamentals' (JIMF) -- relative-inflation terms in policy rules carry exchange-rate predictability; the transmission channel for gap-change conditioning

Rogoff (1996) 'The Purchasing Power Parity Puzzle' (JEL) -- multi-year real-adjustment half-lives: fast offsetting flows cannot erase a realized inflation-differential shock within the holding horizon
Hong & Stein (1999) gradual information diffusion (JPE) -- the slow-diffuser class that turns a persistent macro state into weeks-scale spot drift
Taylor (1993) discretional policy-response lags -- policy moves at meeting cadence behind realized inflation, leaving repricing incomplete at any instant (why the slow window exists at all)

universe.note: Funded pairs ONLY (P0/P2 census). Each pair conditioned by the 63-day change of its home-vs-US y/y inflation differential. Monthly-home pairs (GB, CA) update ~13x/yr; quarterly-home pairs (AU, NZ) update 4x/yr with monthly US-leg motion between home prints.

transform_semantics.gap: gap_p(x) = pi_h(latest print as-of x) - pi_US(latest print as-of x); computed under a SINGLE as-of parameter x per snapshot (AX2-C2); each leg truncated at its own availability instant under that parameter.
transform_semantics.momentum: M(t) = gap_p(t) - gap_p(t - 63 calendar days); BOTH snapshots as-bound at their own instants (the earlier gap is never recomputed at current vintage); no interpolation between prints -- the state is piecewise constant in both snapshots.
transform_semantics.rebase_safety: y/y steps chained across rebase segments via overlap splice (AU in-S0 vintage 2018-10-09, AX2-C3); a 63d window straddling a rebase uses the spliced chain, never raw level differences.
transform_semantics.zero_spot_content: the driver M(t) is a function of realized CPI series ONLY; spot is solely the traded instrument; no FX return/range/session/reaction quantity enters any conditioning variable.
transform_semantics.first_difference_not_level: the gap LEVEL appears nowhere in the anchor; it exists only inside the control arm, where it belongs (V8 AX2-C8 discipline applied to this family's own exposure form).
transform_semantics.lags: no discretionary lags; AX2-C4 availability structurally; I-Q mutation binding: a print arriving k periods late shifts the consumed decision exactly k periods in BOTH snapshots.

decision_clock.rule: AX2-C4 on both snapshot legs; one decision per clock per pair; state persists between prints (quarterly-home pairs move only at US-leg prints between home quarters)
decision_clock.calendar_conditioning: print instants condition the STATE (only times the driver changes); no trade window opens/closes at releases and no hold is anchored to release proximity -- +7d sham MANDATORY (declared into the neighbour slot)

warmup.description: Requires y/y chain (12 print periods) + a 63-day earlier snapshot => >= ~16 print periods of per-leg history before the first binding decision; staged vintaged archives provide decades of pre-S0 depth, so warmup is satisfied from staged bytes: usable grid = full S0 2018-04-04..2025-07-24 (~1905 weekday clocks per pair).
warmup.data_requirements_declared: staged vintaged archives + pinned calendars only (P0/P2 census fields). Spot leg = TD re-acquisition (SAMPLE_DEMONSTRATED); full re-staging is the I-phase prerequisite -- failure closes the family BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION.

entry_exit_fills.activation: enter at the decision clock when flat and in-region: M >= +0.15pp => long home (per home_sign_map); M <= -0.15pp => short home
entry_exit_fills.exit: exit on sign flip of M or |M| <= 0.10pp hysteresis, evaluated after a 5-binding-clock minimum hold; hard max hold 63 binding clocks with immediate re-entry next clock if still in-region
entry_exit_fills.reentry: allowed at the next clock if activation re-fires; max one position per pair
entry_exit_fills.fills: at the decision-instant price (daily 16:00-NY snapshot); no intraday actions; no stops/targets beyond frozen exits
entry_exit_fills.sizing: fixed notional 1 unit per pair; per-trade return in bps of notional

costs.books: dual book mandatory: price-only and financing-adjusted; gates on financing-adjusted at tier 2.0 primary; price-only must not invert sign (p3 rule 6)
costs.cost_sanity: dwell ~20-60 binding clocks against 6.0 bps round trip => required gross drift ~0.1-0.3 bps/clock; break_even_bps_le_1.5 floor gate applies (p3 rule 5)

arms.name: 63-day inflation-differential momentum state book
arms.driver: M(t) = gap_p(t) - gap_p(t-63cd) as defined in transform_semantics
arms.activation: |M| >= 0.15pp in, |M| <= 0.10pp out, min hold 5 clocks, max hold 63 clocks, direction per home_sign_map
arms.mechanism_bearing_component: the FIRST DIFFERENCE (rate-of-change) of the home-vs-US realized-inflation differential

arms.name: +7d sham-calendar variant (MANDATORY sham; declared into the neighbour slot per d1 packet)
arms.driver: identical rule, with every print's binding instant (pinned calendars and US realtime_start dates) shifted +7 calendar days in BOTH snapshots when constructing the state path
arms.delta_vs_anchor: state timing relative to true availability ONLY; thresholds, holds, universe, costs, sign map identical
arms.expected_behaviour: content-driven momentum must not survive a uniform one-week schedule displacement; a sham matching or out-earning the anchor falsifies (R2)

arms.name: differential-LEVEL control (relative-inflation level form; momentum removed)
arms.driver: gap_p(t) alone; activation |gap| >= 0.50pp in, |gap| <= 0.35pp out (level-scale thresholds, frozen), same min/max holds, clock, sign map, costs
arms.delta_vs_anchor: ONLY the mechanism-bearing component (the first difference) is replaced by the level form; everything else identical
arms.expected_behaviour: if spot prices the gap's level rather than its change, the control reproduces or out-earns the anchor (R1) and the momentum identity is words; the control is ALSO the arm that measures any kinship with pure relative-inflation-level exposure (disclosed D2 rho channel vs lane-A4 territory)

control_identifiability: Control differs from anchor ONLY in driver order (first difference -> level) with level-scale thresholds frozen ex ante; neighbour differs ONLY in the +7d schedule displacement; universe, clock grid, holds' shape, fills, sizing and costs identical across arms. No arm subsumes another: a level state is not a function of its 63-day change (both can move independently), and the sham's driver is time-displaced content -- three distinct conditioning paths, rho-measured pairwise and against forbidden ancestry at D2.

falsification_rule.evaluation_book: financing-adjusted, tier 2.0 primary, pooled S0 usable grid
rules: R1 momentum-content kill: control (differential LEVEL) fin-adj expectancy > 0 AND >= 0.5 x anchor fin-adj expectancy => FAMILY DIES (the rate-of-change identity is words over generic relative-inflation-level exposure).
R2 sham-calendar kill: neighbour (+7d sham) fin-adj expectancy >= anchor fin-adj expectancy AND > 0 => the print schedule, not momentum content, drives the book => FAMILY DIES.
R3 fragility kill: anchor fin-adj expectancy > 0 AND neighbour fin-adj expectancy <= 0 while R1 clear is the ONLY passing neighbour configuration; anchor <= 0 => gate 1 mechanical reject.

survival requires: anchor > 0 AND R1..R3 clear AND all ten p3 baseline gates pass (tier-2.0 expectancy positive; pf >= 1.10; >= 2/3 populated folds positive STRICT; pair concentration <= 0.40; break-even <= 1.5 bps; dual-book no inversion; LOPO sign-robust; stress tier 2.0 non-negative margin; USD-drift diagnostic; mechanism sanity -- control must NOT reproduce anchor).

sham_calendar.applicability: MANDATORY, PRESENT -- print instants condition the state path (quarterly step function especially), so the +7d sham is required and occupies the neighbour slot (declared)
sham_calendar.artifact: artifacts/sham_control_calendar.jsonl per the p3 diagnostic contract conditional

expected_failure_interpretation: If R1 fires: the 'differential momentum' PnL was relative-inflation-level exposure in first-difference clothing -- record under E.2 cluster discipline, no descendants, no sign flips; the level form itself is NOT thereby promoted (it failed as control; any future level-form family needs its own preregistration and D2 rho measurement vs lane-A4 territory). If R2 fires: quarterly/monthly print-schedule timing, not inflation content, produced the book -- the V5 sham-shadow class, closed. If gates kill on costs/folds/stress while R1-R2 clear: gap-change content is real but too slow or too small after 6.0 bps round trips. If D2 novelty pools |rho| > 0.20 vs any forbidden ancestry exposure: family withdrawn pre-scoring without comment. Every failure falsifies the mechanism family, not the parameterization: no window, threshold, lag or sign may be re-entered; unused slots never reassigned.

fold_structure.rule: equal thirds of the usable decision grid (2018-04-04..2025-07-24), split mechanically at run time
fold_structure.gate_binding: positive populated folds >= 2 of 3 (p3 rule 3, STRICT margin > 0); each fold independently populated or family closes VACUOUS pre-scoring

lane_boundary_note: Lane A4 owns the deviation-from-anchor construction (spot ratio minus cumulative relative CPI). This proposal's driver is the RATE-OF-CHANGE of the pure-CPI differential -- a first difference with ZERO spot content -- structurally disjoint from A4's level-of-misalignment axis; the gap LEVEL appears only inside this family's control arm (V8 AX2-C8 discipline: the exposure-form shadow lives where it belongs, in the control). The lane-1 nominal-exposure mandate is not imported; the control serves this family's own identifiability. The V9 self-referential veto (nominal-price-trend in new words) cannot bind by construction -- no price series enters any driver -- but pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the V8 nominal-LEVEL shadow, the carry region and lane-A4 exposures is MEASURED at D2, never asserted.

ancestry_distinctness.vs_policy_rate_carry_V3R_and_relabels: no policy rates, no vol gating, no yield differential; 'carry' appears nowhere in the rule; D2 rho vs the carry region measured, not argued
ancestry_distinctness.vs_commodity_bloc_risk_off_V4: no event baskets, no risk-off conditioning
ancestry_distinctness.vs_release_window_avoidance_V5: no windows avoided or entered; book holds through prints; +7d sham measures schedule kinship rather than asserting absence
ancestry_distinctness.vs_reaction_direction_V6_V7: STRUCTURAL: V6/V7 read FX reaction signs after releases. This driver never reads an FX quantity -- it reads the 63-day change of a realized-CPI differential; holds are calendar-independent (5/63 binding clocks); because the state still updates AT print instants, pooled |rho| vs V6/V7 WILL be measured at D2 -- the sham arm plus the zero-reaction-data construction are the registered differentiators
ancestry_distinctness.vs_eurusd_lead_lag_V7: no cross-pair price lead-lag; drivers are macro-leg constructs per pair
ancestry_distinctness.vs_V8_breakeven_dispersion: no TIPS/breakeven series; realized official CPI only
ancestry_distinctness.vs_V8_nominal_yield_LEVEL_shadow: no yields anywhere; D2 pooled rho vs the shadow measured on conditioning exposures
ancestry_distinctness.vs_FRED_real_rate_lane: no real-rate construction; CPI index levels only
ancestry_distinctness.vs_A4_ppp_deviation_and_V9_nominal_trend: A4's conditioning embeds spot (deviation-from-anchor); this driver's first-difference form contains no spot and no price trend; distinctness is structural, with D2 rho measured against both shadows regardless
